items.quote: “This woman said to me, ‘Give up your son so we may eat him today, and tomorrow we’ll eat my son.’
items.contrast: The first son is the son of the woman speaking to the king, not the son of the other woman.
items.reason: Inside the reported speech, “This woman” says “your son” to the woman who is now addressing the king, while reserving “my son” for the next day. Resolving the nested pronouns establishes whose son was to be eaten first.
